propositions: A new locked commit-and-push entrypoint must stage and commit dirty tracker changes before delegating to the push primitive, preserving uncommitted inbound events and bridge-bot authorship.
The entrypoint must acquire and hold a write lock, check for rebase/merge-recovery state before staging, and raise merge-recovery-blocked or warn/return based on strict mode.
Supplied author name and email must be applied per-commit via git -c flags without mutating global or repository config; ambient identity must be used when omitted.
Clean but locally-ahead trackers must push without creating empty commits; persistent rejection under strict mode must preserve the local commit and raise PushDeliveryError rather than succeed.

Lock, staging, and commit failures must raise dependency-defined PushDeliveryError with stable reasons in strict mode, or warn and return without invoking push while retaining dirty content in default mode.
The direct push_tickets_branch primitive must remain push-only and the private CLI adapter must route commit-and-push arguments while preserving the existing push action.
